title: Kanbus is the spot queue
description:
The backlog is Kanbus. Open chores labeled spot are eligible. Enqueue is kbs create --type chore --label spot. Dispatch sets in_progress. Preempt returns the issue to open with a comment. Done is kbs close.

Spotticus must not keep a parallel queue.json or other issue store. All reads and writes go through kbs.

DoD: enqueue/list/dispatch/preempt/close are specified against a temp Kanbus project. No second backlog exists in the product.
